map.根据火场痕迹与线索，辅助分析起火点位置、起火原因并生成调查清单: Analyse the fire's origin and cause from scene traces and clues, and generate an investigation checklist.
map.火场痕迹线索（勾选观察到的痕迹）: Fire-scene trace clues (check the traces observed)
map.炭化深度由深变浅方向: Direction of charring depth from deep to shallow
map.V型/倒锥型炭化痕迹的顶点通常指向起火点，是判断起火点位置最重要的痕迹之一: The apex of a V-shaped/inverted-cone charring pattern usually points to the point of origin and is one of the most important traces for locating it
map.炭化最深处通常为起火点，沿火势蔓延方向逐渐变浅: The deepest charring is usually the point of origin, becoming gradually shallower along the direction of fire spread
map.导线熔痕（短路熔珠）、金属构件异常变色、配电箱/插座附近起火: Melt marks on conductors (short-circuit beads), abnormal discoloration of metal members, fire near distribution boxes/sockets
map.一次短路熔珠（火灾前短路）vs 二次短路熔珠（火灾中短路）须金相分析区分: Primary short-circuit beads (short circuit before the fire) vs secondary short-circuit beads (short circuit during the fire) must be distinguished by metallographic analysis
map.多个独立起火点、助燃剂残留、异常猛烈燃烧、门窗被故意打开助燃: Multiple independent points of origin, accelerant residue, abnormally intense burning, doors/windows deliberately opened to feed the fire
map.火灾调查须由专业火灾调查人员执行，本工具仅提供分析辅助参考，不能替代正式调查结论: Fire investigation must be carried out by professional fire investigators; this tool only provides analytical reference and cannot replace a formal investigation conclusion.
map.📚 深度解析：火灾调查辅助判定: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fire Investigation Decision Support
map.火调人员按现场痕迹线索（熔痕、烟熏、蔓延方向）勾选，辅助判断起火点与起火原因。: Fire investigators check the scene trace clues (melt marks, smoke staining, spread direction) to help determine the point of origin and cause.
map.培训中演示常见起火原因类别（电气/用火不慎/吸烟/自燃/纵火/雷击）的特征。: In training, demonstrate the characteristics of common cause-of-ignition categories (electrical/careless use of fire/smoking/spontaneous combustion/arson/lightning).
map.出具火灾事故认定书前，用工具生成标准调查清单，确保证据链完整。: Before issuing a fire-incident determination, use the tool to generate a standard investigation checklist to ensure the chain of evidence is complete.
map.50 m² 住宅火场的线索评估: Clue assessment of a 50 m² residential fire scene
map.按默认参数（过火面积 50 m²、建筑类型住宅、未勾选任何痕迹线索）：工具提示「: With the default parameters (burned area 50 m², building type residence, no trace clues checked): the tool prompts 'Not enough trace clues checked; further fire-scene inspection to collect trace evidence is recommended' and lists common causes of ignition (electrical, careless use of fire, smoking, spontaneous combustion, arson, lightning, etc.) for reference. The investigation checklist covers 7 items including scene protection, photographic records, plan drawing, interview records and facility-actuation verification.
map.工具能直接认定起火原因吗？: Can the tool determine the cause of ignition directly?
map.不能。本工具仅按勾选的痕迹线索做辅助分析与清单提示，起火原因须结合物证鉴定、现场: No. This tool only performs supporting analysis and checklist prompts based on the checked trace clues; the cause of ignition must be judged jointly with physical evidence examination, scene inspection and interview records, and the fire-incident determination is final.
map.为什么强调先保护火场？: Why is protecting the fire scene first emphasized?
map.痕迹物证（如短路熔珠、燃烧图痕）极易在清理与踩踏中破坏，保护现场、规范取证是后续: Trace evidence (such as short-circuit beads and burn patterns) is easily destroyed during clearing and foot traffic; protecting the scene and collecting evidence properly are prerequisites for an accurate determination later, so the first item on the tool's checklist requires setting up a cordon and barring unauthorized persons.
map.根据火场痕迹（V型痕、炭化梯度、烟熏等）和起火原因线索，辅助分析起火点位置与起火: From fire-scene traces (V-patterns, charring gradients, smoke staining, etc.) and cause-of-ignition clues, aid analysis of the point of origin and cause, and generate an investigation checklist.
